author: AtditC
body:
It looks like people just stopped to vote... If you really want to help Avicus at its 'bad times', you should start voting.



http://minecraftservers.org/vote/38340



What can you do if you want to vote, but you just forget to?
When you use Google Chrome:
Simply add the vote page to your "startup pages" in google chrome, for that, go to 
chrome://settings (or click on Settings in the right corner) and make it look like this (click on Set pages)
 


If you do so, each time you start google chrome, your browser will open the vote page, so you don't forget to vote.

Greetings,
Atdit



P.S don't forget to vote!1
